commit.message:
Fix shared CUDA probe history ownership and MPI cleanup

Keep probe-history construction, initialization and deletion inside
libopalx using out-of-line helpers and a stateless custom deleter.
This prevents executable-side template and vtable instantiations from
selecting unregistered CUDA kernels during resize and MPI migration.

Remove the redundant LossDataSink destructor barrier while preserving
normal save synchronization. Add regressions for history preservation
during growth, stable particle IDs and rank-local cleanup.

Document the ownership boundary, registration order and remaining
collective HDF5 error-handling limitations.

Validation: six focused CTest targets pass with OpenMP and shared CUDA
on A100, including all ten probe cases on one and two MPI ranks.
